end.parentNote: Sameer practised multiplication-by-10 and multiplication-by-100 patterns, plus using doubling to work with products involving 25. They explained the zero pattern and kept checking whether their answers made sense. There was a mix-up about doubling both numbers and treating the new product as unchanged; it was discussed, but the idea was still being clarified at the end. At home, practise 25 × 4, 25 × 8, and 25 × 16 using 25 × 4 = 100 as an anchor, then check each answer with estimation.
